note: BH-7656. How long a pool machine idles after a job before it exits 0 and autostops. fly/builder-runner.sh reads it at the start of each idle wait (_pool_idle_timeout): env POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S, then the per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.pool_idle_timeout_s`, then the lane row, then 600. A value that is not an integer in [60, 7200] is refused (one log line, 600). The RESULT survives autostop in the pool-result row (BH-2643; RB- rebase keys since BH-7656), so the window only needs to cover a job push, not the hub reap gap.
